1479-4488-5700-5701-8345.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-4488-5700-5701-8345.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Rampaging Baloths trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Rampaging Baloths trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield untapped as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Rampaging Baloths triggers.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Rampaging Baloths trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Rampaging Baloths triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

3490-5231-6824-8319.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3490-5231-6824-8319.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Greenhouse Propagator triggers, causing you to gain life.
Spider-Man triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}
Resolve the Spider-Man trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

4247-4419-4694-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
4247-4419-4694-7306.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Renata.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 1.

687-2034-2138-4613-8130.description:
Cast Lazotep Reaver by paying its mana cost; it enters with a vigilance counter due to Tayam.
When Lazotep Reaver enters, it triggers, creating a 0/0 creature token with a +1/+1 counter on it as well as a vigilance counter due to Tayam.
Declare that you are activating Tayam's ability, so state-based actions will not be checked until the ability is activated.
While paying that ability's cost, activate the creature token using the Wall of Roots mana ability from Agatha's Soul Cauldron by putting a -0/-1 counter on it, adding {G}.
Complete the activation by paying {3} and removing a vigilance counter from each of the two creatures and a -0/-1 counter from the Army token.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing Lazotep Reaver and the creature token, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Resolve Tayam's ability, milling three and returning Lazotep Reaver from your graveyard to the battlefield with a vigilance counter on it.
Repeat from step 2.
687-2034-2138-4613-8130.notes: This order of operations (and the additional {2} starting mana) are necessary because you must activate mana abilities before paying costs, and so you cannot use Ashnod's Altar to get mana from the creature you need to remove counters from.

225-2577-6797-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control another Zombie.
You control a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
225-2577-6797-7084.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping the land.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

549-856-6748-6757-8095.description:
Cast Cauldron Familiar by paying {B}.
When Cauldron Familiar enters, it and Weapons Manufacturing trigger.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Weapons Manufacturing trigger, creating a Munitions artifact token.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing the Munitions, as it is a Food due to Ragost.
The Munitions triggers, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

206-222-527-6495.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
206-222-527-6495.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Evereth twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.
206-222-527-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

622-757-5087-5663.easyPrerequisites: Magosi has at least one eon counter on it and does not have summoning sickness.
622-757-5087-5663.description:
During your precombat main phase, use Cayth to put an additional eon counter on Magosi.
Activate Magosi's third ability by tapping it, removing an eon counter from it and returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
When Magosi leaves the battlefield, The Ozolith's first ability triggers due to Kamahl, putting an eon counter on The Ozolith.
Resolve the Magosi ability, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Play Magosi.
At the beginning of your combat phase, The Ozolith triggers, moving an eon counter from itself onto Magosi.
Repeat each turn.

301-4419-4738.description:
Activate Goblin Sledder by sacrificing Putrid Goblin.
When Putrid Goblin dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Renata.
Resolve the Goblin Sledder ability.
Repeat.

2034-5295-6970-7763-7850.description:
Cast Abby from the command zone by paying {1}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
Abby triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Fungus Zombie creature tokens named Cordyceps Infected equal to the amount of mana spent to cast it.
When Abby enters under an opponent's control, Mirror of Life Trapping triggers, exiling Abby.
Choose to return Abby from exile to the command zone.
Activate two Codryceps Infected tokens by tapping them, adding {R}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Cordyceps Infected token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat step 6 until you have enough mana to cast Abby.
Repeat from step 1.

2523-2869-3680.description:
Cast Stunt Double by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Ratadrabik.
Put Stunt Double into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Stunt Double dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a token copy of Stunt Double that is a copy of Ratadrabik but is a 2/2 Zombie in addition to its other types.
Repeat from step 2 using the Stunt Double token instead.
2523-2869-3680.notes: This combo produces a mandatory infinite loop that'll cause the game to end in a draw if it isn't interacted with.

224-1170-7529--82.description:
Activate the creature that taps for mana by tapping it, adding at least {1}{G}.
Cast the copy of Rampant Growth from exile by paying {1}{G}, unpreparing Studious First-Year.
When you cast that spell, Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Studious First-Year, which enters prepared.
Resolve Rampant Growth, searching your library for a basic land and putting it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers, untapping the creature that taps for mana.
Repeat.
224-1170-7529--82.notes: Only the creatures that tap for green mana will work. The creature must tap for at least {2}{G} for this combo to add near-infinite mana.

240-2921-4742-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bartolomé del Presidio
Repeat from step 2.

1687-4050-6290.notablePrerequisites:
You have max speed.
You control an additional creature.
1687-4050-6290.description:
Cast Lightwheel Enhancements either from your hand or from your graveyard by paying {W}, attaching it to another creature you control.
When Lightwheel Enhancements enters the battlefield, Siona triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature with Lightwheel Enhancements attached, adding {W}.
Repeat.

4200-4681-5231.description:
Cast Icewind Stalwart by paying its mana cost.
When Icewind Stalwart enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Karmic Guide
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing Icewind Stalwart.
Resolve the Icewind Stalwart ability, blinking Karmic Guide
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Icewind Stalwart from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

2558-5123-5687-6798.notablePrerequisites: You control no more than two additional creatures.
2558-5123-5687-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Skittering Precursor triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield as a 1/1 due to Jetmir, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Eldrazi Spawn.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

598-924-5173.notablePrerequisites: Liliana has at least three loyalty counters.
598-924-5173.description:
Activate Liliana's third loyalty ability by removing three loyalty counters from it, allowing you to cast Zombie spells from your graveyard this turn.
Activate Phyrexian Ghoul by sacrificing Shambling Ghast.
When Shambing Ghast dies, it triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phyrexian Ghoul ability, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Shambling Ghast from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat from step 2.

1386-2492-2845-3556.description:
Cast Bonus Round by paying {1}{R}{R}, causing each player to copy each instant or sorcery spell they cast this turn.
Cast Flicker by paying {1}{W}, targeting Meldweb Curator.
Bonus Round triggers, copying Flicker targeting Quintorius Kand.
Resolve the copy of Flicker, blinking Quintorius Kand.
Resolve the original Flicker, blinking Meldweb Curator.
When Meldweb Curator enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting Flicker on top of your library from your graveyard.
Activate Quintorius Kand's second loyalty ability by removing three loyalty counters from it, causing you to exile Flicker from the top of your library and cast it without paying its mana cost, targeting Meldweb Curator.
Quintorius Kand and Bonus Round trigger.
Resolve the Quintorius Kand trigger, dealing 2 damage to each opponent and causing you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the Bonus Round trigger, copying Flicker targeting Quintorius Kand.
Repeat from step 4.

1939-4017-4186.notablePrerequisites:
Sunbond attached to Scurry Oak.
You have a way to gain life.
1939-4017-4186.description:
Gain any amount of life.
Scurry Oak triggers, putting that many +1/+1 counters on itself.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters the battlefield, Lunarch Veteran triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1766-1978-3789.description:
Animate Thran Dynamo using The Blackstaff of Waterdeep.
Activate Thran Dynamo by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Thran Dynamo.
Repeat from step 2.

1537-2499-3337.notablePrerequisites:
Reflection of Kiki-Jiki does not have summoning sickness.
You control a creature that can tap to produce at least {1}.
1537-2499-3337.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Reflection of Kiki-Jiki by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Zealous Conscripts with haste.
When the Zealous Conscripts token enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, untapping Reflection of Kiki-Jiki and the mana-producing creature.
Repeat.

280-2178-4913-5310.notablePrerequisites:
Zimone and Dina does not have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff attached to Zimone and Dina.
280-2178-4913-5310.description:
Activate Zimone and Dina by tapping it and sacrificing Bloodghast.
When Bloodghast dies, Zimone and Dina triggers, untapping Zimone and Dina.
Resolve the Zimone and Dina ability from step 1, causing you to draw a card and put Golgari Rot Farm from your hand onto the battlefield, and then repeat this process once if you control eight or more lands, putting any other land from your hand onto the battlefield instead.
 When Golgari Rot Farm enters the battlefield, it and Bloodghast trigger.
Resolve the Golgari Rot Farm trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Bloodghast trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
